what: The generic product: upload ANY legacy decision log (a CSV of inputs + the system's decision), re-grow a sovereign replacement, PROVE equivalence on held-out rows the model never saw, surface every mismatch, and download a runnable owned replacement model + a signed migration receipt. Proven here on a frozen 1,200-row log the generic kernel was NOT hand-coded for.

claims.text: With ZERO hand-coding, the generic re-grower reproduces the legacy engine on held-out rows, well above its 3-class base rate
It parsed and typed the log itself: 1,200 rows, 12 features, the decision auto-picked, 3 decision classes
THE SAFETY GATE: every mismatch is surfaced, nothing hidden — the invariant same + mismatches === total holds
THE PRODUCT: the downloaded owned replacement imports and predicts correctly on raw rows, its receipt verifies, and a tampered receipt is rejected
claims.check: modelApprove === 'APPROVE' && modelDecline === 'DECLINE' && modelReceiptVerifies === true && receiptVerifies === true && tamperRejected === true

claims.text: It flags its OWN uncertainty — low-confidence leaves are surfaced as candidate misunderstandings, not silently kept
